# Naitrust

> Naitrust is a protected-commerce and sourcing platform for Nigerian individuals and businesses.

Naitrust helps users discover verified suppliers in China and Nigeria, browse products in English, request a confirmed landed-cost quote, pay through a protected order, and track delivery. Business accounts can both source products and publish a marketplace showcase.

Detailed product and brand context: https://naitrust.com/llms-full.txt

## Core experiences

- Market: public supplier, product, service, Showcase, and Trust Profile discovery.
- Cart and quotes: authenticated users build one-supplier carts and receive time-limited confirmed quotes.
- Protected orders: product payment, logistics, evidence, messages, inspection, customs, delivery, refunds, and release stay in one Order Room.
- Business commerce: businesses can source like any buyer and can also publish products, fulfil orders, and receive earnings.
- Agents: users may optionally hire a verified independent sourcing or inspection agent under a separate service agreement.
- Production workflows: business buyers can connect product, packaging, labelling, inspection and shipping stages across multiple approved suppliers.
- Currency: Naira is the default. Eligible business quotes may offer USD payment, while China partner settlement may use CNY or USD through a regulated provider.
- Partner network: China-based agents and suppliers use separate reviewed, invite-only access with English and Simplified Chinese support.
- Wallet: order funding, refunds, supplier earnings, agent earnings, and verified-account withdrawals.

## Important boundaries

- China and Nigeria are the active staged markets. Japan, Thailand, and the United States are Coming soon.
- Catalogue prices are estimates until Naitrust issues a confirmed quote.
- Naitrust does not directly hold customer funds; regulated partners provide applicable money movement.
- Verification, agent recommendations, and protected orders are not guarantees.
- Agents never control supplier purchase funds.
- Legacy payment features may remain accessible but are not the primary product.
